statement.zh: Bonavia 1982 正式专论报告瓦尔梅谷洛斯加维拉内斯前陶贮粮坑与相关植物遗存。
statement.en: Bonavia 1982 is the primary monograph reporting Preceramic storage pits and associated botanical remains at Los Gavilanes (Huarmey).
